thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we want to publish the CinderFlow customer story on Wednesday. Need final quote + legal OK by EOD tomorrow. Can CS confirm customer is comfortable with the cost-savings numbers?
kevin: Spoke with Ana (CinderFlow). She's ok with publishing a percent number and a high-level quote, but wants to see the exact wording before it goes live. Asks for an embargo window of 7 days after sign-off.
jake: Got it. I'll draft a hero quote and a short technical blurb. Can someone confirm the verified metric? Is it cost-per-inference or overall spend reduction?
sophie: Legal — happy to review. We need the source for any metric (internal report or anonymized query) and a copy of the customer's sign-off email. Also watch language around "guarantee" and "always".
kevin: It's a measured drop in inference spend. CinderFlow ran a 6-week pilot on our quantized model profile — they reported a 37% reduction in monthly GPU spend vs baseline. I'll attach the pilot summary in a follow-up.
maria: Perfect. Jake, please include the 37% figure and a one-line caveat like "based on a 6-week pilot". Sophie — can you pre-approve the boilerplate phrasing so we can move fast?
jake: Drafting now. Quick check: do we want an executive quote (CEO) or technical (CTO)? CEO works for the launch hero; CTO can add a technical sidebar.
kevin: They prefer the CTO quote for accuracy. Ana said CTO Mia will give a short comment. I'll try to get it by midday tomorrow.
jake: Draft quote coming — posting for pre-review:```"Using Redwood Inference reduced our monthly GPU spend by 37% during a six-week pilot, enabling us to serve larger batches with lower latency and predictable costs." — Mia Chen, CTO, CinderFlow```
sophie: Looks fine but change "reduced" -> "reduced on average" and add parenthetical on pilot size. Suggest: "reduced on average by 37% during a six-week pilot (n=3 models)." Can you add the pilot sample size, Kevin?
kevin: Confirmed: pilot was 3 models (prod transformer variants) across two regions. I'll get the exact wording and an approval email from Mia by 11:30.
maria: Great — once we have that approval, marketing will finalize the case page, social posts, and the launch email. Jake, assume embargo until legal signs off + 7 days per customer request. Calendar-bot: Scheduling note — draft review meeting added Thu 12:00-12:30.
jake: Thanks — I'll post the full draft in this thread by 10:45 so Sophie can do a quick pre-check. Planning a short hero + 3 bullets (savings, latency, rollout time) + 30s customer clip ask.
sophie: I'll prioritize the review. If wording matches my suggestion and we have the sign-off email, legal OK should be quick.
maria: Quick checklist for tomorrow: 1) Approved quote text (Kevin) 2) Sign-off email (Kevin) 3) Pilot summary screenshot (Kevin) 4) Draft case copy + social teasers (Jake) 5) Legal pre-approval (Sophie). Marking priority: HIGH — Wednesday publish.
kevin: On it. Will ping Ana now and follow up here.
maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: — ping if there are blockers, otherwise we proceed on the timeline.
